description.value: Ichiban Sushi Restaurant is a fully licensed Japanese restaurant in Courtenay serving a broad menu of sushi rolls, nigiri, miso soup, gyoza, tempura, and appies. The restaurant welcomes dine-in guests or phone-ahead pickup orders, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the Comox Valley. Sake, Japanese beer, and plum wine round out a menu that also includes vegetarian and gluten-free options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content clearly confirms the OSM name, phone (250-703-2156 matches +1-250-703-2156), and address (932 Fitzgerald Ave, Courtenay, BC). The website explicitly mentions takeout by phone pickup and lists vegetarian and gluten-free menu options. No evidence on the site for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging.
concerns: Website URL was discovered (not present in OSM tags) with medium confidence; the domain ichiban.coltonhornstein.com is a subdomain of what appears to be the web designer's personal domain (footer credits 'Codama Design'), which is non-standard but the content clearly matches this business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, licensed restaurant in Courtenay with a confirmed web presence and phone number; a useful dine-in and takeout stop for touring cyclists in the Comox Valley.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states: 'including vegetarian and gluten-free options in the full menu.'
